optimizer.selection: Final EMA at step 12000; no PACO/Test method selection
optimizer.preservation: FP32 final-LN patch cosine, original frozen same Full384 reference
optimizer.denominator: sum fractional content coverage, then average nonzero-valid images

gradient_rules.U1: gc_proj +0.5gg +lambda*gp, projecting whole-encoder gc once only when dot<0 and norms valid
gradient_rules.U2: rho*gc +0.5gg +lambda*gp; same projection computation, original crop direction

protocol.precision: P2 BF16 autocast forward; FP32 weights and unscaled FP32 loss gradients; no GradScaler
protocol.projection: One global coefficient from all trainable Encoder parameter gradients in fixed named_parameters order
protocol.parameter_unused: A parameter unused by all three losses keeps grad=None, preserving P2 AdamW behavior
protocol.initial_preflight: Fixed actual COCO stream batches linspace(0,11999,8), same exclusions; Original and existing P2 final12000 EMA
protocol.PACO: Same Official Val2410, bilinearROIAlign24, R2 seed0/init7,10epochs; max Object/Part mean with earlier tie
protocol.ADE: Mandatory for both; unchanged src.g1eval.ade; world2/batch16/40k, frozen encoder, separate same-init Linear768→150 heads, final iteration

gpu_plan.background: Coexist with existing managed A/B; no worker interruption

protocol.mathematical_limits: U1 equals adaptive preservation weighting; U2 matches crop gradient norm, not composite or AdamW parameter update norm

preflight.midpoint_note: No P2 step6000 weights remain; only the saved final12000 EMA is used. No P2 replay.
preflight.precision: Existing P2 BF16 autocast forward, FP32 weights and unscaled per-loss gradients, no GradScaler.
preflight.summation_note: BF16 reverse-mode rounding can differ between three separate VJPs and one total-loss VJP. Both formulas use identical forward tensors. Error measured at fixed2% relative-L2 tolerance; no residual correction.

execution.ddp: Separate independent one-GPU experiments; multi-rank projection is not enabled
